## Pull Request Checklist

Please confirm each item before submitting:

- [ ] I added only one JSON file inside the `contributors/` folder.
- [ ] My file name matches my GitHub username.
- [ ] I did not edit another contributor's file.
- [ ] My JSON is valid.
- [ ] I ran `python scripts/validate_contributors.py` or `python -m json.tool`.
- [ ] I included my LinkedIn post URL below.
- [ ] My PR contains no unrelated changes.

## Contributor File

Paste your file path:

```text
contributors/your-github-username.json
```

## LinkedIn Post URL

Paste your public LinkedIn post URL:

```text
https://www.linkedin.com/posts/your-post-link
```

## Notes

Add any helpful context for maintainers:

```text
Optional notes here
```
